lines.en: label dormwartwo11:
scene maidwar1
: Goooooood morning Vietnaaaaaam! And by Vietnam, I mean Kumon-mi because I’m realizing now that none of you understood that reference.
lines.zh: : 早————上好，越南————！不过我说的「越南」，指的是 Kumon-mi，因为我现在才意识到，你们没一个听得懂这个梗。

lines.en: : But that’s fine because you’ll only be paying minimal attention to me while two of our most antisocial students duke it out to see which one of them is best at being the complete opposite of themselves!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系，因为你们只会把一丁点注意力放在我身上，剩下的就看我们两位最不合群的学生大打出手的——看看她们谁最擅长扮演和自己完全相反的人！

lines.en: : Special thanks once again to the Produce Delivery Administration and the Tsukioka Foundation for sponsoring the event, as well as...whatever the name of Uta’s maid cafe is!
lines.zh: : 再次特别感谢农产品配送管理局和 Tsukioka 基金会赞助本次活动，还有……不管 Uta 那家女仆咖啡厅叫什么名字！

lines.en: : There is no need for a name when we exist in the shadows.
lines.zh: : 既然我们存在于阴影之中，就不必有名字。

lines.en: : You say, despite the giant sign out front advertising that there is a maid cafe here!
lines.zh: : 你是这么说的，可门口那块大招牌明明写着这里有家女仆咖啡厅！

lines.en: : A sign is but a symbol of what can never be.
lines.zh: : 招牌不过是永远不可能成为现实之物的一个象征。

lines.en: : The things you’re saying make less and less sense as the days go by so either you’re running out of steam or have suddenly become the world’s worst method actor.
lines.zh: : 你说的话一天比一天更没道理，所以你要么是灵感耗尽了，要么是突然变成了全世界最烂的方法派演员。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Spoken like someone who has never seen Suicide Squad.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。这话一听就是没看过《自杀小队》的人说的。

lines.en: : Well, apologies for having {i}taste,{/i} Molly! But before this devolves into a debate about movies, let’s get back to the method acting thing!
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉我有{i}品味{/i}，Molly！不过在这变成一场电影辩论之前，我们还是回到方法派演技的话题上吧！

lines.en: scene maidwar2
: Folks, being a maid is more than just ketchup and cumshots-
lines.zh: : 各位，当女仆可不只是番茄酱和颜射——

lines.en: : Not that type of cafe.
lines.zh: : 不是那种咖啡厅。

lines.en: : It’s about embodying the role of someone who lives for the sole purpose of someone else!
lines.zh: : 而是要体现出那样一个角色——她活着，只为另一个人！

lines.en: : And while it has become eerily apparent to me that that combination of words already describes a good half of you in regard to my Senpai, it’s not enough! For maids have an element of cuteness as well!
lines.zh: : 虽然我已经惊恐地发现，这句话已经能形容你们当中足足一半人对我的前辈的心态，但那还不够！因为女仆还得有可爱的成分！

lines.en: : Imani, are you saying some of us aren’t cute?
lines.zh: : Imani，你是说我们有些人不够可爱吗？

lines.en: scene maidwar3
: I’m saying some of you have evolved {i}past{/i} cuteness and are now extremely sexualized, anthropomorphized animals!
lines.zh: : 我是说，你们有些人已经{i}超越{/i}了可爱，进化成了被极度性化、人格化的动物！

lines.en: : Aww! Come over here and let me lick you.
lines.zh: : 哇！过来让我舔舔你。

lines.en: : Do not tempt me with a good time!
lines.zh: : 别拿好事来诱惑我！

lines.en: : Like, seriously. These last two days have been rough.
lines.zh: : 说真的。这两天可真难熬。

lines.en: : But that’s enough of me since I’m sure you’re all raring to go!
lines.zh: : 不过我就不多说了，我相信你们都摩拳擦掌了！

lines.en: : In just a few short minutes, both of our competitors should be ready and we can kick things off.
lines.zh: : 再过短短几分钟，两位参赛选手就该准备好了，我们就能开始了。

lines.en: : So for now...sit back, relax, and enjoy the complimentary tea and breakfast!
lines.zh: : 所以现在……坐好，放松，享用免费提供的茶和早餐吧！

lines.en: scene black
Imani’s speech comes to an end and I lean back in my chair, awaiting a day I didn’t think would ever come- seeing Maya in a maid costume.
lines.zh: Imani 的讲话结束，我往椅背上一靠，等待着那个我以为永远不会到来的一天——看见 Maya 穿上女仆装。

lines.en: Of course I’m excited to be waited on by Io as well but, apparently, she’s going to stay in her butler costume and play {i}that{/i} role instead of the traditional maid.
lines.zh: 我当然也很期待被 Io 伺候，不过显然她打算继续穿她的管家制服、演{i}那个{/i}角色，而不是传统的女仆。

lines.en: Either way, I have entrusted my wallet to Futaba for the rest of the morning so as to not tempt me into immediately emptying its contents in front of whoever goes first.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我把钱包托付给了 Futaba，今天上午都放在她那儿，免得我忍不住在第一个上场的人面前立刻把钱全花光。

lines.en: Which, if we’re deciding based on whoever the first one out of the locker room is, will be Io.
lines.zh: 而如果按谁先从更衣室出来决定顺序，那就会是 Io。

lines.en: scene maidwar4
: Morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Sorry for not wearing a dress. Dresses look stupid on me and make me remember that I have a vagina. Which is a thing I probably shouldn’t be saying out loud, but...anyway, hi. Io here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没穿裙子。裙子穿在我身上很蠢，还会让我想起自己有个阴道。这种话我大概不该大声说出来，不过……总之，你好。我是 Io。

lines.en: : You seem nervous?
lines.zh: : 你看起来很紧张？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve got pills that are supposed to take care of that, but Uta said I’ve been taking too many lately and that they might affect my, uhh...{i}performance.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。我有药能治这个，不过 Uta 说我最近吃太多了，可能会影响我的……呃……{i}发挥{/i}。

lines.en: : Was that supposed to sound sexual in nature or no?
lines.zh: : 那句话本来是想带点性暗示，还是不想？

lines.en: : No. It wasn’t. But if thinking it was brings me closer to winning, that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不。本来不是。不过如果你以为它是就能让我离胜利更近，那也行。

lines.en: : Because, even if I can’t stand the vast majority of my floor, having you with me, uhh...wherever it is you wind up being forced to sleep...will sort of counteract that.
lines.zh: : 因为，就算我受不了我们楼层绝大多数的家伙，只要有你在……呃……不管你最后被迫睡在哪个地方……多少都能抵消掉一些。

lines.en: : Should I have sucked it up and worn the dress after all? I feel like that’s a thing I should have done. Just tell me to go get changed and I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 我是不是该忍忍把裙子穿上才对？我觉得那是我该做的事。你只要叫我去换，我就去换。

lines.en: : You’re fine the way you are. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 你现在这样很好。别担心。

lines.en: : We both know that’s a lie, but thank you anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都知道那是假话，不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: : Psst...the wind blows...in this general direction...
lines.zh: : 嘶……风……正往这个大概的方向吹……

lines.en: : I think Uta wants you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Uta 在叫你。

lines.en: : Just ignore her. She’ll go away.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她会自己走开的。

lines.en: : PSSSSST!!!
scene maidwar5
: Ugh! What do you want?!
lines.zh: : 呃！你到底想干嘛？！

lines.en: scene black
Uta pulls Io aside to, most likely, give her some form of pep talk before the competition begins.
lines.zh: Uta 把 Io 拉到一边，大概是在比赛开始前给她打某种气。

lines.en: Either that or the two of them have a secret, lesbian relationship with one another and Uta simply couldn’t wait to get her hands on her best friend anymore.
lines.zh: 又或者，她们两个其实有一段秘密的、女同性恋式的关系，而 Uta 只是再也等不及要把手伸向她最好的朋友了。

lines.en: Which is fair and better than the first thing I imagined, so that’s what I’m going to go with instead.
lines.zh: 那也说得通，而且比我最初想象的更好，所以我决定就这么认为了。

lines.en: : Oh, good. You’re already thinking of something disgusting and you haven’t even seen me yet. Wonderful.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。你都还没看见我，就已经在想什么恶心事了。真是太棒了。

lines.en: scene maidwar6
: Stop reading my- oh boy.
lines.zh: : 别再读我的——哦，天哪。

lines.en: : Yes. I am adorable. Thank you for noticing.
lines.zh: : 是的。我很可爱。谢谢你的注意。

lines.en: : I think you were born to wear that outfit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你天生就是穿这身衣服的料。

lines.en: : That’s actually very funny since wearing it makes me wish I was never born at all.
lines.zh: : 这话其实很好笑，因为穿上它让我恨不得自己从来没出生过。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you even agreed to this. I figured you’d just take the loss if it meant embarrassing yourself in front of me.
lines.zh: : 我很意外你居然答应了。我本来以为，如果要在你面前丢脸，你宁可直接认输。

lines.en: : I am not {i}embarrassing{/i} myself. Something like this is well within my capabilities.
lines.zh: : 我不是在{i}丢脸{/i}。这种事完全在我的能力范围之内。

lines.en: : What irritates me is the fact that I must do it for {i}you{/i} and the inevitable plethora of jokes you will make about it in the future.
lines.zh: : 让我恼火的是，我必须为了{i}你{/i}做这件事，而你以后一定会拿它开无数个玩笑。

lines.en: : If I’m not too busy masturbating, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说，如果我没有忙着打飞机的话。

lines.en: scene maidwar7
: You’re disgusting. But I don’t blame you. This is a once in a lifetime opportunity and I was aware of the consequences when I signed on.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。不过我不怪你。这是千载难逢的机会，我在答应的时候就知道会有什么后果。

lines.en: : Fortunately for you, my victory will be ensured by the month worth of buffet tickets Ayane has promised me in exchange for it.
lines.zh: : 对你来说幸运的是，我的胜利会由 Ayane 承诺给我的一整个月的自助餐券来保证。

lines.en: : Just make sure you’re extra nice to me. I don’t like tsundere maids.
lines.zh: : 只要记得对我格外好一点就行。我可不喜欢傲娇女仆。

lines.en: scene maidwar8
: You will like whatever I tell you to like and that’s final.
lines.zh: : 我让你喜欢什么，你就得喜欢什么，就这么定了。

lines.en: : Have you met Niki yet? Because I think you two might have more in common than you think.
lines.zh: : 你见过 Niki 了吗？因为我觉得你们两个的共同点可能比你以为的还要多。

lines.en: : Yeah. Me too.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我也这么觉得。

lines.en: : Maya! Io! Gather round because shit’s about to take off!
lines.zh: : Maya！Io！都过来，好戏马上开演！

lines.en: scene black
scene maidwar9
: The rules are plain and simple. Whoever is a better maid...or butler...wins.
lines.zh: : 规则简单明了。谁更像个好女仆……或者好管家……谁就赢。

lines.en: : We’re going to set this up in a sort of...wheel around the service worker system. So you two will take turns getting short bursts of service in before swapping places.
lines.zh: : 我们要把这场比赛搞成一种……围绕服务业工作制的轮转。所以你们两个要轮流上场，各自提供一小段服务，然后交换位置。

lines.en: : We’ll be using the order you two came out of the locker room in to determine who goes first, so...Io. You’re up.
lines.zh: : 我们会按你们两个从更衣室出来的顺序决定谁先上，所以……Io。你先来。

lines.en: : Shit. What if I went back in there and then came out again? Would that put me at the back of the order?
lines.zh: : 操。那要是我再回更衣室、然后再出来一次呢？那样我就排到最后了吗？

lines.en: : Go, you must. And butler, you shall.
lines.zh: : 你必须去。而管家，你应当如此。

lines.en: : There are no strict rules determining what is and isn’t good maid-slash-butlering, so use your knowledge of Sensei to better suit his exact needs and desires.
lines.zh: : 没有严格规定什么算好的女仆／管家服务，所以尽情用你们对老师的了解，去贴合他确切的需求和欲望。

lines.en: : Right. But what are we supposed to do if we want to keep our clothes {i}on?{/i}
lines.zh: : 好。不过如果我们想把衣服{i}穿着{/i}，该怎么办？

lines.en: : Accept defeat, I guess? Beats me. But I ain’t judging this one! So, without further ado...
lines.zh: : 认输吧，我猜？我可不知道。不过这一场我不当裁判！所以，废话少说……

lines.en: scene black
: Io...attack!
lines.zh: : Io……上！

lines.en: Io steels herself and tries to calm her nerves.
lines.zh: Io 咬牙稳住心神，试着让自己平静下来。

lines.en: Of course, she fails miserably. But Uta is there to give her yet another pep talk (Without any secret lesbian contact, as far as I can tell) before she sighs heavily and makes her way over to my table...
lines.zh: 当然，她惨败了。不过 Uta 又在那儿给她打了一次气（据我所知，没有任何秘密的女同性恋接触），之后她重重地叹了口气，朝我的桌子走来……

lines.en: scene maidwar10
: Welcome back to...Unnamed Cafe, Young Master.
lines.zh: : 欢迎再次光临……无名咖啡厅，少爷。

lines.en: : It will be my pleasure to...assist you with all of your...clothed desires this fine after...morning. Not afternoon. It’s morning now.
lines.zh: : 我很荣幸能……在这个美好的下……上午，为您……所有穿着衣服的欲望提供服务。不是下午。现在是上午。

lines.en: : It certainly is.
lines.zh: : 确实是。

lines.en: : Could I perhaps interest you in a spot of...omelet? Or tea? Which is what I probably should have brought over here, but...
lines.zh: : 您是否有兴趣来一点……煎蛋卷？或者茶？那才是我本该端过来的东西，不过……

lines.en: : Omelet?
lines.zh: : 煎蛋卷？

lines.en: : Sure. I was just about to order that anyway. Great predictive thinking, Io.
lines.zh: : 好啊。反正我正要点那个。预判得很准嘛，Io。

lines.en: scene maidwar11
: O...Of course, Young Master! It is my greatest pleasure to always be of clothed service to you.
lines.zh: : 当……当然，少爷！能随时为您提供穿着衣服的服务，是我最大的荣幸。

lines.en: : So if there is anything else I can do to-
lines.zh: : 那么如果还有什么我能做的——

lines.en: : Time! Maya, go!
lines.zh: : 时间到！Maya，上！

lines.en: scene maidwar12
: What? Already?
lines.zh: : 什么？已经？

lines.en: : Oh, thank god. Are we done? Is that it?
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。结束了吗？就这样？

lines.en: : Does my presence disturb you, {i}Master?{/i} Would you like me to retrieve your previous servant?
lines.zh: : 我的存在打扰到您了吗，{i}主人{/i}？您要我把上一位仆人叫回来吗？

lines.en: : Or are you going to shut up and let me win my buffet tickets?
lines.zh: : 还是说您打算闭嘴，让我把自助餐券赢到手？

lines.en: : I want Io back. Bring me the butler.
lines.zh: : 我要 Io 回来。把管家给我叫来。

lines.en: : Maya, out! Io in!
lines.zh: : Maya 退场！Io 上！

lines.en: scene maidwar13
: What?! Again?! And where did I get this second omelet?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！又来？！还有我这第二份煎蛋卷是从哪儿变出来的？！

lines.en: : Never question the mystery omelet.
lines.zh: : 永远不要质疑神秘煎蛋卷。

lines.en: scene maidwar14
: Uhh...hi! I guess things didn’t work out with Maya or something, so...here I am! Your...maid...ler.
lines.zh: : 呃……你好！看来你和 Maya 那边不太顺利什么的，所以……我又来了！你的……女仆……管家。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Io out. Maya in?
lines.zh: : Io 退场。Maya 上？

lines.en: scene maidwar15
: Hah...
: Woah, it actually worked.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，居然真的奏效了。

lines.en: : Not to be rude, but you two are pretty fucking bad at this.
lines.zh: : 不是我无礼，不过你们两个这干得可真他妈烂。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re just a bad customer? Constantly swapping out maids and butlers like they’re socks...who exactly do you think you are?
lines.zh: : 也许是你这个客人太差劲？不停地换女仆和管家，就像换袜子一样……你以为你是谁啊？

lines.en: : I specifically told you I didn’t want a tsundere maid.
lines.zh: : 我特意说过，我不想要傲娇女仆。

lines.en: scene maidwar16
: You did? Oh my gosh, I’m so sorry. I was just so blinded by how happy I was to see you that I must have completely forgotten.
lines.zh: : 我说过吗？哦我的天，真是抱歉。我只是太高兴见到你了，高兴得冲昏了头，一定是全忘了。

lines.en: : Go on...
lines.zh: : 继续……

lines.en: : With what? You already have your entree. My job here is done.
lines.zh: : 继续什么？您的主菜已经上了。我的活儿干完了。

lines.en: : I mean...you could always get me a drink?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你总可以给我拿杯饮料吧？

lines.en: : Maya out. Io in.
lines.zh: : Maya 退场。Io 上。

lines.en: scene maidwar17
: Hi! Io again! And I brought a drink this time! Look!
lines.zh: : 你好！又是 Io！而且这次我带了饮料！你看！

lines.en: : That makes the score two points for Io and zero points for Maya. Do I win yet?
lines.zh: : 这样一来比分就是 Io 两分、Maya 零分了。我赢了吗？

lines.en: : Go back to talking like a butler. You’re just talking like Io right now.
lines.zh: : 回到管家的语气去。你现在说话就是 Io 本人在讲。

lines.en: scene maidwar18
: Understood, Young Master. Of course Io would not be good enough for you. You deserve only the most attentive of servants, and I am but a lowly peon meant to do your bidding.
lines.zh: : 明白了，少爷。当然，光是 Io 是配不上您的。您值得拥有最体贴的仆人，而我不过是个卑微的喽啰，只配听您差遣。

lines.en: : Again, clothed.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，穿着衣服。

lines.en: : Io out. Uta-chan in.
lines.zh: : Io 退场。Uta 酱进场。

lines.en: scene maidwar19
: Yes, Master?
lines.zh: : 是，主人？

lines.en: scene maidwar20
: Wait, you tricked me! I’m not supposed to be up here!
lines.zh: : 等等，你耍我！现在不该轮到我上来的！

lines.en: : Don’t leave. I need you.
lines.zh: : 别走。我需要你。

lines.en: : Uta-chan out! Maya in!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱退场！Maya 上！

lines.en: scene maidwar21
: Hi.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : This is the worst contest yet.
lines.zh: : 这是目前为止最糟糕的一场比赛。

lines.en: : I actually quite like this format. It means I never have to see you for more than several seconds at a time.
lines.zh: : 我其实还挺喜欢这个形式的。这意味着我一次最多只要看你几秒钟。

lines.en: : It’s extremely ideal for me.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说再理想不过了。

lines.en: : Would it kill you to at least {i}try{/i} and be nice?
lines.zh: : 你至少{i}试着{/i}友善一点会死吗？

lines.en: : Probably. Maya out again. Io in.
lines.zh: : 大概会。Maya 再次退场。Io 上。

lines.en: scene maidwar22
: Are you also starting to get dizzy?
lines.zh: : 你也有点开始晕了吗？

lines.en: : A little. But maybe if you have a sip of the drink I didn’t order and the omelet I haven’t been able to touch yet, some of that nausea will go away?
lines.zh: : 有一点。不过也许你喝一口我没点的饮料、再吃一口我到现在都还没碰过的煎蛋卷，那种恶心感就会消失？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how long this has to go on for? I kind of want to sit down.
lines.zh: : 你知道这还得持续多久吗？我有点想坐下了。

lines.en: : Just sit here. It’s not like there’s any actual format to this contest at this point and I doubt anyone will care.
lines.zh: : 就坐这儿吧。反正到这个地步，这场比赛也没什么真正的格式了，我怀疑也没人会在意。

lines.en: : Sure. That sounds good.
lines.zh: : 好啊。听起来不错。

lines.en: : Io sit. Maya in.
lines.zh: : Io 坐下。Maya 上。

lines.en: scene maidwar23
: You traitor.
lines.zh: : 你这个叛徒。

lines.en: : Can I get an omelet as well? And maybe some coffee?
lines.zh: : 我也能要一份煎蛋卷吗？也许再来点咖啡？

lines.en: : I am not here to serve you.
lines.zh: : 我不是来伺候你的。

lines.en: : You’re not here to serve me either.
lines.zh: : 你也不是来伺候我的。

lines.en: scene maidwar24
: In fact, Io is already two points ahead of you and it’s starting to look like those buffet tickets of yours are just a pipe dream.
lines.zh: : 事实上，Io 已经领先你两分了，而你那几张自助餐券看起来越来越像是白日梦了。

lines.en: : You’ll regret saying those words to me.
lines.zh: : 你会后悔对我说那些话的。

lines.en: : Will I? Because it seems to me like you {i}have{/i} to do something to redeem yourself at this point or you’re basically screwed.
lines.zh: : 会吗？因为在我看来，到这个地步你{i}得{/i}做点什么来挽回自己，否则你就基本完蛋了。

lines.en: : I am warning you...
lines.zh: : 我在警告你……

lines.en: : Hey, maid girl? I still haven’t gotten my coffee and it’s been...almost fifteen seconds. So if you could hurry it up a little bit, that would be great. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嘿，女仆小姐？我的咖啡还没来，而且已经……差不多十五秒了。所以如果你能稍微快一点，那就太好了。谢谢。

lines.en: scene maidwar25
: Hah...
: Please forget everything you are about to see.
lines.zh: : 请忘掉你即将看到的一切。

lines.en: : What? What does-
lines.zh: : 什么？什么意——

lines.en: scene maidwar26
: Hiya, Master! Moe Moe Maya here!
lines.zh: : 您好呀，主人！这里是萌萌 Maya！

lines.en: : Oh no! Effort! My greatest weakness!
lines.zh: : 哦不！卖力！我最大的弱点！

lines.en: : It looks to me like somebody is a little hungry! Is there anything I can whip up for ya that’ll bring a smile to that big ole’ handsome face of yours?
lines.zh: : 我看呐，有个人是有点饿了！我给您整点什么，能让那张又大又帅的脸上露出笑容呢？

lines.en: : As much as I...appreciate the sudden effort...I already have-
lines.zh: : 虽然我很……欣赏你突然这么卖力……可我已经有——

lines.en: scene maidwar27
: You mean you’re not gonna order something from me?...After I tried {i}sooooo{/i} hard to work up the courage to talk to you? You’re gonna bweak my widdle heart.
lines.zh: : 你是说你不打算跟我点东西吗？……在我{i}那么那么{/i}努力地鼓起勇气跟你说话之后？你要伤透人家的心了啦。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Io...I can’t resist...much longer...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Io……我忍不住了……撑不了多久了……

lines.en: : Fight it! Fight it, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 忍住！忍住啊，老师！

lines.en: scene maidwar28
: Please, Master?...Can’t you do this one little thing for me?...
lines.zh: : 求你了，主人？……你就不能为我做这么一件小事吗？……

lines.en: : If you don’t buy any food from Moe Moe Maya, she’ll have to sleep on the streets. And she gets {i}so scared{/i} when she has to do that...
lines.zh: : 如果你不跟萌萌 Maya 买点吃的，她就只能睡大街了。而她每次不得不那样的时候，都会{i}很害怕{/i}……

lines.en: scene maidwar29
: Oh! Here’s an idea! What if I throw in my biggest, most enthusiastic Moe Moe beam totally free of charge? Would {i}that{/i} make you happy?
lines.zh: : 哦！我有个主意！要是我免费附送我最强大、最热情的萌萌射线呢？{i}那样{/i}你会开心吗？

lines.en: : Yes. One of everything, please. And also...will you marry-
lines.zh: : 会。每样都来一份，谢谢。还有……你愿意嫁——

lines.en: scene maidwar30
: No. Maya out.
lines.zh: : 不行。Maya 退场。

lines.en: scene maidwar31
: Uhh...uhh!
: Io in!
lines.zh: : Io 上！

lines.en: scene maidwar32
: How...How do I do the beam thing?!
lines.zh: : 怎……怎么发射那个射线啊？！

lines.en: : Io...beeeeaaaam?
: It’s no use...you haven’t trained enough, Io. You'll only hurt yourself.
lines.zh: : 没用的……你的修为还不够，Io。你只会伤到自己。

lines.en: : But...I brought you things! And I didn’t flip you off!
lines.zh: : 可……我给你拿了东西！而且我还没对你竖中指！

lines.en: : So what if I’m not as good of an actor as Maya?! Isn’t she only doing this for food anyway?! Shouldn’t what matters most be heart?!
lines.zh: : 我演技不如 Maya 又怎么样？！她做这些不就是为了吃的吗？！最重要的难道不该是真心吗？！

lines.en: : Io out. Maya in.
lines.zh: : Io 退场。Maya 上。

lines.en: scene maidwar33
: No! It’s too soon!
lines.zh: : 不！太快了！

lines.en: scene maidwar34

: I’m having a new, {i}special{/i} omelet prepared just for you, Master. But, in the meantime...how about I cast my beam on that sorry excuse for an omelet you already have in front of you and make it edible?
lines.zh: : 我正在让人专门为您准备一份全新的{i}特制{/i}煎蛋卷，主人。不过在那之前……不如我把射线打在您面前那份蹩脚的煎蛋卷上，让它变得能吃？

lines.en: : Take that back! I’ll have you know that someone probably worked...moderately hard on that! But I’m not really sure as I just took it off the counter!
lines.zh: : 收回那句话！我得告诉你，做那份的人大概……还挺用心的！不过我也不太确定，因为我是直接从柜台上拿的！

lines.en: : Beam me up, Scotty.
lines.zh: : 把我传送上去吧，Scotty。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Oh, Master. You sure do say some funny things sometimes. But that’s just what Moe Moe Maya loves so much about you.
lines.zh: : 哦，主人。您有时候说的可真逗。不过萌萌 Maya 最爱您的就是这一点。

lines.en: : I don’t like how good you are at this.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这么擅长这个。

lines.en: : Just wait until you get a taste of how delicious {i}I{/i} am.
lines.zh: : 等你尝到{i}我{/i}有多美味再说吧。

lines.en: scene maidwar35
: Whoops! Did I say {i}me?{/i} Because what I really meant to say was my food. Teehee!
lines.zh: : 哎呀！我刚才说的是{i}「我」{/i}吗？我真正想说的是「我的菜」。嘻嘻！

lines.en: Somewhere deep inside of my chest, a heart grows back.
lines.zh: 在我胸腔深处的某处，一颗心脏重新长了出来。

lines.en: scene maidwar36
: Soft and sweet and full of cream! Happy hearts and hungry dreams! Cuteness turned up to extreme! Give this boy a MOE BEAM!!!
lines.zh: : 又软又甜又满是奶油！快乐的心和饥饿的梦！可爱度拉到极致！给这小子来一发萌射线！！！

lines.en: scene maidwar37
: Ahh! Her beam was fully capitalized! That means it’s a max level maid beam! It’s on par with mine!
lines.zh: : 啊！她的射线全是大写字母！那意味着这是满级女仆射线！和我的不相上下！

lines.en: : And her focal lines are blocking us out! Who knew Maya possessed this much power?!
lines.zh: : 而且她的集中线把我们全都挡在外面了！谁知道 Maya 居然拥有这么强大的力量？！

lines.en: scene black
scene maidwar38
: Well...I think it’s safe to say that we all know who the winner of this competition is.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想可以放心地说，我们都知道这场比赛的赢家是谁了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Uta...I let you down. We all knew it already, but it appears that I’m really not cut out to be a maid.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Uta……我让你失望了。其实我们早就知道了，不过看来我真的不是当女仆的料。

lines.en: : And it appears that I will not be going hungry any time soon.
lines.zh: : 而看来我短期内是不会挨饿了。

lines.en: : The wind...wishes to know if you are looking for a part time job...
lines.zh: : 风……想知道你是否正在找一份兼职……

lines.en: : I’m already in the guillotine. Just hurry up and chop my head off already so I can go home and take my pills.
lines.zh: : 我的头已经在断头台上了。赶紧把我的头砍下来吧，好让我回家吃药。

lines.en: scene maidwar39
: You heard her, Senpai! Say the words so we can get on with the last day of the Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 你听到了，前辈！把那句话说了，我们好继续宿舍大战的最后一天！

lines.en: : Fine, fine...
: The winner is...
lines.zh: : 获胜者是……

lines.en: menu:
Maya
lines.zh: Maya

lines.en: : ...obviously Maya.
lines.zh: : ……显然是 Maya。

lines.en: : Still got it.
lines.zh: : 宝刀未老。

lines.en: : Still? Have you done this-
lines.zh: : 宝刀未老？你以前做过——

lines.en: scene maidwar40
: No. Now, please excuse me as I put my actual costume back on and all of us forget this ever happened.
lines.zh: : 没有。现在请恕我失陪，我要把我真正的衣服换回来，然后我们所有人都把这件事忘掉。

lines.en: $ dorm1war2points += 1
$ maidwarmaya = True
Io
lines.zh: Io

lines.en: : Of course it-
lines.zh: : 当然是——

lines.en: scene maidwar41
: Me? What? Huh? Io? Io is the winner? Why? Huh? Io?
lines.zh: : 我？什么？哈？Io？Io 赢了？为什么？哈？Io？

lines.en: : Somewhere in the distance...a...sparrow...drowns in a lake?...
lines.zh: : 在远处的某处……一只……麻雀……在湖里淹死了？……

lines.en: : Uhh...you mind shining some light on that decision, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 呃……你能给我们解释一下这个决定吗，前辈？

lines.en: : Please do! Because the only logical explanation I can think of is that you’re only voting {i}against{/i} me because you want to-
lines.zh: : 拜托了！因为我能想到的唯一合理解释，就是你投我{i}反对{/i}票只是因为你想——

lines.en: scene maidwar42
: Oh, you fucking monster of a man.
lines.zh: : 哦，你这个他妈的怪物。

lines.en: : You just want to torment me, don't you?
lines.zh: : 你就是想折磨我，对吧？

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : So...I only won because you want to mess with Maya? Not because of my abilities as a butler-slash-maid?
lines.zh: : 所以……我赢只是因为你想捉弄 Maya？不是因为我的管家／女仆能力？

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: scene maidwar43
: I can live with that! Thanks, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 这我能接受！谢谢您，老师！

lines.en: : There have been many...{i}many{/i} horrible things that I have experienced because of you...
lines.zh: : 因为你，我经历过{i}很多{/i}……很多可怕的事……

lines.en: : But this?...
lines.zh: : 但这一次？……

lines.en: : This is perhaps the worst thing yet.
lines.zh: : 这大概是最糟的一次了。

lines.en: $ dorm2war2points += 1
$ maidwario = True
scene maidwar44
: Well, that...sure was something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那……可真是够可以的。

lines.en: : Something wonderful.
lines.zh: : 是美妙至极的一件事。

lines.en: : I feel as if we’ve been here before.
lines.zh: : 我有种我们以前来过这儿的感觉。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to be stuck in a room full of girls in revealing clothing, but to watch as two of them desperately fight over a man as if it’s sport...my. What a beautiful start to the day.
lines.zh: : 被困在一屋子穿着暴露的女孩里是一回事，可看着其中两个像比赛一样拼命争夺一个男人……哎呀。这是多么美好的一天的开始啊。

lines.en: : It won’t be beautiful for too long, you know. Your contest is up next.
lines.zh: : 不过这份美好不会持续太久的，你知道吗。你的比赛就是下一个。

lines.en: scene maidwar45
: Is it? I haven’t been keeping much track of the schedule.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我没怎么留意赛程。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t take things so lightly if I were you. Yumi’s not going to hold back.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，就不会这么掉以轻心。Yumi 是不会手下留情的。

lines.en: : Oh, is she actually coming? That’s fantastic. I’m excited to see her so the two of us can put an end to this immature feud once and for all.
lines.zh: : 哦，她真的会来吗？那太好了。我很期待见到她，这样我们两个就能一劳永逸地结束这场幼稚的争执了。

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t think that’s something she’s really interested in doing right now. I think she just wants to win the contest and go back home.
lines.zh: : 呃……我觉得她现在其实不太想做那种事。我觉得她只是想赢下比赛，然后回家。

lines.en: : If that’s what she wants, that’s what she’ll get. And I wish her the best of luck as very few people have defeated me in...well, anything.
lines.zh: : 如果那就是她想要的，那就如她所愿。我祝她好运，毕竟在……嗯，任何事情上，能打败我的人都寥寥无几。

lines.en: : You sound pretty...cool with her coming back to participate despite her beating the living shit out of you the last time you saw her.
lines.zh: : 你听起来……倒是挺淡定的，尽管你上次见她时，她把你打得半死，而你还能接受她回来参赛。

lines.en: : I’m alive, aren’t I? And more content than ever, might I add.
lines.zh: : 我还活着，不是吗？而且我得补充一句，我比以往任何时候都更满足。

lines.en: : If you, uhh...
lines.zh: : 如果你，呃……

lines.en: : If you don’t mind me asking...do you think you might have, like...done something to piss her off? Because I’ve never seen Yumi do anything like that to anyone before and...
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意我问的话……你觉得你有没有……做过什么把她惹毛的事？因为我从没见过 Yumi 对谁做出那种事，而且……

lines.en: : Not to suggest anything, but it’s hard for me to believe she’d do that without a reason.
lines.zh: : 我不是想暗示什么，不过我很难相信她会无缘无故那么做。

lines.en: : Me?
if nodokaspecial15p3 == True:
: All {i}I{/i} did was steal her clothes and ask her to masturbate in front of me to completion in order to get them back.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}只不过是偷走了她的衣服，然后要求她在我面前自慰到最后，好把衣服换回去而已。

lines.en: else:
: All {i}I{/i} did was steal her clothes and try to get her to masturbate in front of me. Is that really so bad?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}只不过是偷走了她的衣服，还试着让她在我面前自慰。那真的很过分吗？

lines.en: scene maidwar46
: Ugh. Do you always have to be that perverted? Because if you’re not going to tell me the truth, just forget I even asked.
lines.zh: : 呃。你就非得这么变态吗？既然你不打算告诉我实话，就当我没问过好了。

lines.en: scene maidwar47
: Molly...are you sure you don’t want to invite Tsuneyo over here? She seems a little out of place with Chika and Nodoka, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : Molly……你确定不想把 Tsuneyo 也叫过来吗？她跟 Chika 和 Nodoka 待在一起，看起来有点格格不入，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I’m a bit...uhh...how should I say...at odds with the Kendo Princess following her...{i}performance{/i} from last night.
lines.zh: : 我有点……呃……该怎么说呢……在她昨晚那场……{i}表演{/i}之后，我和剑道公主之间有点不愉快。

lines.en: : I agree that she took things way too far, but...I think she was trying her best.
lines.zh: : 我同意她做得太过了，不过……我觉得她已经尽力了。

lines.en: : Even if her best was...disgusting and used you as...the punchline to...
lines.zh: : 就算她的尽力是……恶心的，还把你当成……笑点……

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, I can understand why you’re upset with her. I just...felt a little bad, I guess.
lines.zh: : 其实，再想想，我能理解你为什么生她的气。我只是……有点替她难过吧，大概。

lines.en: : As do I. And I will confront her about the situation shortly once I...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我也是。等我……呃……之后，我就会去跟她把这件事说清楚。

lines.en: : Find some sort of...charisma-increasing potion.
lines.zh: : 找到某种……能提升魅力的药水。

lines.en: : Please don’t get drunk at a third consecutive Halloween party. It’s my least favorite tradition.
lines.zh: : 拜托别在第三场连续的万圣节派对上喝醉了。那是我最讨厌的传统。

lines.en: : Oh, rest assured...I will not be drinking that much again any time soon...
lines.zh: : 哦，放心吧……我短期内不会再喝那么多了……
